suggestions.title: Tighten the two-agents narration

edits.text: Kristina opens Cursor and starts two agents. One checks SJ's velocity in Jira over the last two sprints. The other builds a Linear-to-Jira connector for Brendan's tickets, a job she told him she'd do by hand. She's a little surprised how fast they move. Opus 4.7 finishes tasks noticeably faster than Opus 4.5. Her next meeting chimes. She joins, leaving them running. Before it ends, both agents report done. The connector has copied a test ticket into Jira. She means to check them after the call, and forgets. SJ's ticket count comes back lowest on the team.

ifDeleted.summary: This is the main home of guardrail 2's payoff: Kristina builds a tool alone with the newest model and it works with nothing to catch. It also plants three things the back half pays off: the overheard 'tickets closed per engineer' line, the July tech-sharing demo, and the Linear-to-Jira tool that only ever copies the test ticket (s19_l20). The build could survive as a narrator coda moved into s11b, but then a third of the scene stays, so a full delete breaks a guardrail and the Nine Tickets reveal.
